title: A priest knocking on Rantidev's door so different than "Please sir may I have some more" Athiti welcoming all and washing feet Even those from Ferenzi
summary: A priest knocking on Rantidev's door so different than "Please sir may I have some more" Athiti welcoming all and washing feet Even those from Ferenzi #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
A priest knocking
on Rantidev's door
so different
than "Please sir may I
have some more"
Athiti
welcoming all and
washing feet
Even those from
Ferenzi
#poetryport
